1. In the camera web UI, for every rule: 1. In the camera web UI, for every rule you want to receive (Event > Smart Event / Basic Event), open Linkage Method and tick 'Notify Surveillance Center'. Enabling a rule alone does not send it over ISAPI.
2. Create a camera user with remote noti: 2. Create a camera user with remote notification / alarm permission. Administrator rights are not needed.
3. Check access from the ioBroker host:: 3. Check access from the ioBroker host: curl --digest -N -u USER 'http://CAMERA_IP/ISAPI/Event/notification/alertStream' (curl asks for the password). Events and a heartbeat should appear.
The adapter is read-only: it never chang: The adapter is read-only: it never changes detection rules, schedules, linkage or network settings.
Stream: the adapter connects to the came: Stream: the adapter connects to the camera (recommended). Push: the camera sends alerts to the adapter's push listener
Optional. Only used by cameras whose mod: Optional. Only used by cameras whose mode is Push. Stream mode is recommended: it detects lost connections, push mode cannot.
Camera: Configuration > Network > Advanc: Camera: Configuration > Network > Advanced Settings > Alarm Server (HTTP Listening): destination IP = this ioBroker host, URL = /, port = listener port, protocol HTTP. Then tick 'Notify Surveillance Center' in each rule's linkage.
Only requests from the IP addresses of c: Only requests from the IP addresses of configured push cameras are accepted. Keep the port reachable from the camera network only.
Fetch one JPEG from the camera for each: Fetch one JPEG from the camera for each new trigger and keep the latest in the adapter file storage
Recent triggers kept per camera in lastE: Recent triggers kept per camera in lastEvent.history (0 = off)
Add one card per camera with the + butto: Add one card per camera with the + button. Fill in name, address and login, then press Test connection. Detection rules (line crossing, intrusion, ...) are configured in the camera itself; this adapter only listens.
Scan a subnet for Hikvision cameras and: Scan a subnet for Hikvision cameras and add all of them with the same login. Save your settings first: after a successful scan the new cameras are saved and this page reloads.
Each address gets one read-only request: Each address gets one read-only request with HTTP Digest login; devices that reject the login are listed but not added. Cameras that are already configured are skipped.
